subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

UNESCO is __committed__ to protecting individual privacy and securing the personal information made available to us when you visit unesco.org, as well as UNESCO pages on other sites.
solution:
The correct answer is '**devoted**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word "**committed**" refers to being dedicated or devoted to something (समर्पित).

 
 
• **Example**: She is **committed **to her work, often staying late to ensure projects are completed on time.
 
 
 
• The correct word "**devoted**" means showing deep affection or loyalty to someone or something (समर्पित or भक्त).
 
 
• **Example**: He is **devoted **to his family, always putting their needs before his own.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym is **devoted**.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Disloyal **means not loyal or faithful; betraying trust (विश्वासघाती).
 
• **Unfaithful **means not faithful; not loyal or consistent (विश्वासघाती or बेवफ़ा).
 
• **Inconstant **means frequently changing; variable or irregular (अस्थिर).
